title: Skin Changer
limitations:
[h2]Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Only pure cosmetic providers recognized from standard PCK resources or known visual patch targets can be switched. Mods marked [code]affects_gameplay=true[/code] are treated as part of the gameplay baseline and will not appear as skins; mixed mods incorrectly marked as cosmetic may lose required code when isolated.
[*]Provider DLL initializers and global patches are intentionally not executed. Skins that generate visuals at runtime or depend on custom C# logic, external files, settings, or unsupported shader, material, or animation code may be incomplete or fail.
[*]Encrypted, sparse, unsupported-version, or otherwise non-standard PCK archives cannot be scanned.
[*]Obfuscated or unusual resource paths, card names, model IDs, and patch targets may not be recognized automatically.
[*]Scenes must include their dependencies and use compatible Godot nodes and skeleton or Spine structures. Custom scripts, missing dependencies, renamed nodes, or incompatible rigs may display incorrectly, and a compendium preview may differ from gameplay.
[*]Duplicate Mod IDs, missing or circular dependencies, incompatible minimum game versions, or loading Skin Changer after the skin providers can prevent full takeover and allow the providers' original forced patches to conflict.
[*]Game updates or skin Mod updates can temporarily break compatibility. Please report the Mod name, affected character, card, monster, or Ancient, and the relevant log.
[/list]
description:
Switch character, monster, card, and Ancient scene skins. An Ancient compendium is added to the Compendium so Ancient skins can be selected conveniently.

[h1]NO RESTART! SWITCH AND USE INSTANTLY![/h1]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch character skins from character select
[*]Switch card skins by character or color in the card compendium, or select a skin for an individual card
[*]Switch monster skins in the monster compendium and adjust each monster-and-skin scale from 50% to 200%
[*]Use the added Ancient compendium to preview and switch Ancient scene skins
[*]Apply selected resources immediately and save every selection automatically
[*]Isolate forced cosmetic patches so unselected skins cannot take over resources
[/list]

[h2]Important[/h2]
Place this mod first in the load order so it can manage cosmetic resources consistently. If it is not first, the in-game warning can move it to the top and restart automatically.

This manager only controls skin mods that you have installed and enabled. It does not bundle any third-party skin assets.

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
https://github.com/gurio-wine/STS2-SkinChanger

[h2]Version[/h2]
0.9.29

This mod was developed with substantial assistance from GPT and DeepSeek. More feature requests and suggestions are welcome!
